title: Invading armies, subterfuge and conquest: How fire ant wars affect ecosystems
summary: Ants disperse seeds, scavenge, turn soil and serve as a food source in their ecosystems. If local ants are displaced by invasive ants from elsewhere, the effects are widely felt.
